newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: UBS looks to help Czech bank stake sale - paper.
newsitem.headline: UBS looks to help Czech bank stake sale - paper.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) is looking to help the Czech government sell a 20 percent stake in commercial bank Komercni Banka a.s., the economic daily Hospodarske Noviny reported on Wednesday.
The paper, quoting Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus's economic adviser Martin Kocourek, said UBS is also seeking to win a mandate to help arrange the sale of a 31 percent state stake in bank IPB a.s..
Officials from all three banks were not immediately available for comment, nor was Kocourek.
Under the Komercni plan, Kocourek said UBS would buy 20 percent of the state's 49 percent stake in the bank, and then "wait until instructions come from the government on how to deal with it".
UBS would have no voting rights while it held the shares, and the government would hold the right to buy back the shares, he added.
By participating in the sale of the IPB shares, Kocourek said UBS would help lend confidence in the privatisation plan of the bank.
